BATCH A APPROVED as one batch — every FIX recommendation of rebuild/m2/AUDIT-REGISTER.md becomes an approved repair direction: D1 APPROVED-FIX · D2 APPROVED-FIX · D3 APPROVED-FIX · D4 APPROVED-FIX · D5 APPROVED-FIX · D6 APPROVED-FIX · D7 APPROVED-FIX · D9 APPROVED-FIX · D11 APPROVED-FIX · D12 APPROVED-FIX · D13 APPROVED-FIX · D14 APPROVED-FIX · D15 APPROVED-FIX · D17 APPROVED-FIX · D18 APPROVED-FIX · D19 APPROVED-FIX · D20 APPROVED-FIX · D21 APPROVED-FIX · D22 APPROVED-FIX · D23 APPROVED-FIX · D24 APPROVED-FIX · D26 APPROVED-FIX · D27 APPROVED-FIX · D28 APPROVED-FIX · D29 APPROVED-FIX · D30 APPROVED-FIX · D31 APPROVED-FIX · D33 APPROVED-FIX · D34 APPROVED-FIX · D35 APPROVED-FIX · D36 APPROVED-FIX · D38 APPROVED-FIX · D39 APPROVED-FIX · D41 APPROVED-FIX · D42 APPROVED-FIX · D43 APPROVED-FIX · D44 APPROVED-FIX · D45 APPROVED-FIX (38). BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set.
